notes.title: DEVBLOG - 21/08
notes.content:
• Item icons now turn gray when the quantity is zero
• Bugfix for the magic shield
• Add credits
• Add explanations at the beginning
• Adjust ice block
• Adjust dialogue with the first boss
• Replace music for the sky phase and other remaining ones
• Item in the sky phase that keeps falling
• Improve bushes in the forest boss fight
• Fix dialogues where the character jumps at the end (still need to adjust dialogues)
• Add more regions that require specific or semi-specific powers to reach
• Check the rainbowray and dark void powers on bosses / boss power weaknesses balancing
• Coins no longer respawn (except when loading a saved game)
• Change color of the third cloud in the sky phase (background)
• Close lighthouse doors in the beach phase
• New music for the mines area
• BUGFIX: Speed magic doesn't work after loading a save, even if marked in the menu
• Magics are now not functioning in the star challenge
• BUGFIX: Bomb fire isn't killing other monsters
• BUGFIX: Missing link between ice alternative route and boss room!!!
• Add more interactive buttons to advance title/cutscenes scenes etc
• BUGFIX: WATER ERROR AGAIN when falling into a hole and returning to solid ground
• BUGFIX: item in the wrong layer in one of the casdun rooms
• Now you can't use items in the star challenge
• Inform in dialogues that now you can't use either magic or items in the star challenge!
• BUGFIX: No more dash issue (no longer infinite dash)
• Replace Double Spark with Quick Spark in the shop
• Adjust Angel Eye power movement
• New music for the sky phase
• Jump is more responsive
• BUGFIX: Credits now display completely
• Powers adjusted for the final boss
• Update control tutorial
• New sound for when enemies take damage
• Voice acting in Brazilian Portuguese!
• Now, in addition to the d-pad, the sticks also move the character!

notes.title: DEVBLOG - 07/24

tags.balance_change: [*] Bouncing eyes easier to dodge;
[*] Balanced Cemetery level;

tags.bug: [*] Bugfix: Desert level no longer bugs on Game Over;
[*] Bugfix: Secret levels (Star Challenge) no longer bug on Game Over;

tags.balance_change: [*] Rats now have only 1 HP;
[*] Some types of slimes now have less HP;

tags.bug: [*] Player no longer gets stuck in the secret alternate route of the Clock Tower;

tags.balance_change: [*] Ice areas have been balanced;

tags.bug: [*] Bugfix: Cannon is no longer dragged by the player;
[*] Bugfix: Treasures in the beach level are now in the correct layer;

tags.feature: [*] Shortcut to the sea can now only be opened with ice power (as it was meant to be from the beginning);

tags.balance_change: [*] Balanced beach level;

tags.bug: [*] Bugfix: MonsterTile for Mushmoon in the Cheese Moon room has been added;

tags.balance_change: [*] Balanced Moon level;
[*] Balanced Desert area;
[*] Balanced Hipoteca Mines area;

tags.bug: [*] Bugfix: Angel Slime now bounces back when hitting a MonsterTile;

tags.balance_change: [*] Balanced Sky area;
[*] Balanced Castle area;
[*] Balanced Casdun area;

tags.feature: [*] Magical buttons are now more visible;
[*] Secret passages now have a clue;

tags.balance_change: [*] Ice is now slightly less slippery;

tags.bug: [*] Bugfix: Character now moves normally after falling into water abysses;

tags.balance_change: [*] Some minor adjustments to Noel's Cave level design;

tags.bug: [*] Bugfix: Correction of a text that should be in Portuguese;

tags.feature: [*] New music for Desert area;
[*] Remix of Beach and Sea music;
[*] Added shadows to missing area holes;

tags.balance_change: [*] Increased duration of the Rapid Shot item;
[*] Adjusted the text of the Magic Shield description;

tags.feature: [*] Changed the icon of the Rapid Shot (in-game);

tags.balance_change: [*] Magic Shield now lasts longer;

tags.bug: [*] Bugfix: Protective rings when opening a save;
[*] Bugfix: Duplicate Castle boss;
[*] Bugfix: Mission item talkbox in the Sky level now appears;

tags.balance_change: [*] Slightly adjusted the character's jump button;

tags.bug: [*] Bugfix: Falling into the hole within the water and respawning inside the water (previously respawning with weird physics);
[*] Bugfix: Secret items in Casdun;

tags.feature: [*] Added broken wall for the secret item room in Casdun;
[*] New music for the Sky level;

tags.balance_change: [*] Minor adjustments to the Tower area level;

tags.bug: [*] Bugfix: Deleted old hidden save points;

tags.balance_change: [*] Minor adjustments to the Village area level.

notes.title: New DEMO!

tags.feature: - New basic shooting system (which improved gameplay);
- Implemented magic teleportal system;
- Added village sidequest;
- New music for the forest area;

tags.bug: - Several bugs were fixed, among them the infamous ladder's bug.
